items.name: Knife
items.desc: Stealth kills, finishing the downed and breaking crates. The edge wears with every strike.

items.name: Crowbar
items.desc: Heavy and quiet. Pries barricades and cracks skulls.

items.name: Crossbow
items.desc: Fires bolts. Extremely quiet: nothing beyond arm's reach hears it.

items.name: Handgun
items.desc: Standard sidearm. Balanced, reliable, takes every handgun attachment.

items.name: Punisher
items.desc: Fast-cycling pistol whose rounds punch through light cover and the first body they meet.

items.name: Yellow9
items.desc: Long-barrelled hard hitter. The most damage a handgun round can do, with the kick to match.

items.name: Whitetail
items.desc: Compact and superbly balanced: the quickest handling of any pistol.

items.name: Matilda
items.desc: Long-slide service pistol. One round for each pull of the trigger, fifteen in the grip.

items.name: Shotgun
items.desc: Pump-action. Close-range stopping power and crowd control.

items.name: Riotgun
items.desc: Semi-automatic with a tight pattern: reaches further than any other shotgun.

items.name: Striker
items.desc: Drum-fed room clearer. Twelve shells, a wide pattern and a short reach.

items.name: Rifle
items.desc: Slow, precise and devastating at range. One round at a time.

items.name: Semi-Auto Rifle
items.desc: Self-loading marksman rifle. Follow-up shots without leaving the scope.

items.name: Full-Auto Rifle
items.desc: Assault rifle. Sustained automatic fire at any practical distance.

items.name: Desert Eagle
items.desc: Magazine-fed magnum. Stops almost anything it hits.

items.name: Killer9
items.desc: Match magnum pistol: faster, flatter and deadlier than it has any right to be.

items.name: Handcannon
items.desc: Five chambers of the heaviest handgun load in the Zone. Loaded round by round.

items.name: SMG
items.desc: Compact machine pistol with a wire stock. Cheap, fast and hungry.

items.name: Tommy Gun
items.desc: Drum-fed classic. Heavier rounds per second than anything else that takes SMG ammo.

items.name: Grenade
items.desc: Thrown explosive. 3.5 second fuse, lethal to everyone nearby including you.

items.name: Grenade (Incendiary)
items.desc: Thrown fire. Bursts into a burning pool that denies ground for several seconds.

items.name: Grenade (Flash)
items.desc: Thrown blinding. Anyone looking at it loses sight and nerve for a few seconds - infected most of all.

items.name: Pipe Bomb
items.desc: Improvised charge. Breaks barricades and thin walls.

items.name: Signal Flare
items.desc: Activates signaled extractions. Burns bright - draws rescuers and hostiles alike.

items.name: Wind-up Alarm Clock
items.desc: Throw it to ring after a few seconds. Infected and patrols investigate the sound.

items.name: Tourniquet
items.desc: Controls heavy extremity bleeding. The limb keeps losing condition until treated.

items.name: Antiviral Medicine
items.desc: Stops the infection. Use it after a bite, before the fever takes hold - or any time before the end.

items.name: Brown Egg
items.desc: A hen's egg. Taken from a chicken; the shop buys them and never sells them. Eaten raw, it is something.

items.name: White Egg
items.desc: A white egg, cleaner and a little larger than the brown ones. Worth more to the shop.

items.name: Golden Egg
items.desc: One hen in a great many lays these. Sell it - or eat it, and feel a good deal better.

items.name: Husky (Dog Whistle)
items.desc: A white husky, yours. Carry the whistle into an operation and the dog deploys at your heel: it follows you, warns of the infected it smells, and goes for whatever attacks you. Stocked at Rank 10.

items.name: Gas Mask
items.desc: Filters toxic spores and reduces radiation uptake.

items.name: Raid Pack (8x6)
items.desc: High-capacity extraction pack. More loot, more weight, more noise.

items.name: Electrical Parts
items.desc: Breakers, fuses and relays. Two sets can restore a substation.

items.name: Gilded Icon
items.desc: Old Quarter relic. Collectors pay well; the cult wants it back.

items.name: Anomalous Shard
items.desc: Faintly warm crystalline growth from the Redline. Mildly radioactive.

items.name: Crypt Key
items.desc: Opens the catacomb gate beneath the cathedral.

items.name: Kessler's Ledger
items.desc: Raider supply routes, bribes and names. Must be physically extracted.

items.name: Purifier Core
items.desc: The heart of the Waterline purifier. Raiders will pay a fortune.

items.name: Flashlight
items.desc: A hand torch. Carry it in your case and the flashlight key turns it on; or fit a Mounted Flashlight to the weapon at the workbench.

items.name: Gun Oil
items.desc: Cleans fouling and rust at the workbench (+25 condition).

items.name: Rabbit's Foot
items.desc: Weapon wear -5%.

items.name: St. Christopher Medal
items.desc: Stamina drain -5%.

items.name: Lost Dog Tags
items.desc: Raid XP +5%.

items.name: Tin Bell (Muffled)
items.desc: Footstep noise -5%.

items.name: Green Herb
items.desc: Heals a sixth of your health. Mix two for a third, or with a Red Herb for nearly all of it.

items.name: Yellow Herb
items.desc: Rare. Raises your maximum health for good - the gain is kept through death, rank resets and prestige - and heals a quarter of it.

items.name: Red Herb
items.desc: Weak alone (a sixth of your health); mixed with a Green Herb it restores five sixths.

items.name: Mixed Herb (G+G)
items.desc: Two Green Herbs ground together. Heals a third of your health.

items.name: Mixed Herb (G+R+Y)
items.desc: Green, Red and Yellow Herb ground together. Restores all of your health, stops bleeding and raises your maximum health for good.

items.name: Mixed Herb (G+R)
items.desc: Green and Red Herb. Heals five sixths of your health and stops bleeding.

items.name: Small Key
items.desc: Opens one locked drawer. Whatever is inside was worth locking away.

items.name: Scrap (Small)
items.desc: Offcuts of steel. Three make a knife.

items.name: Light Gunpowder
items.desc: A small pile of fine powder. Light + light makes handgun rounds; with a plank it makes bolts.

items.name: Heavy Gunpowder
items.desc: A large pile of coarse powder with a yellow-red cast. Heavy + heavy makes magnum rounds.

items.name: Can of Beans
items.desc: Restores hydration and energy. Turns up in sports bags and on sanatorium beds.

items.name: Emerald
items.desc: A vivid green, transparent gemstone. Sockets into treasures.

items.name: Ruby
items.desc: A brilliant, deep crimson gemstone. Sell it, socket it, or trade it as a second currency.

items.name: Diamond
items.desc: A legendary diamond. Very few have ever left the Zone.

items.name: Tarnished Crown
items.desc: Three empty sockets. A ruby, an emerald and a diamond would make it priceless.

items.name: Body Armor
items.desc: Adds 50 protection on top of your health. It takes the damage first.

items.name: Cat Ears
items.desc: An accessory that grants infinite ammo for all weapons.

items.name: Chicken Hat
items.desc: An accessory that reduces all damage taken to 1.

items.name: Deer Antlers
items.desc: An accessory that increases the power of melee attacks.

items.name: Wolf Tail
items.desc: An accessory that increases your movement speed.

items.name: Assault Rifle Ammo
items.desc: Intermediate cartridge for the Semi-Auto and Full-Auto Rifles.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.desc: A large pile of powder. Two make rifle rounds; with light powder, SMG rounds; with heavy, assault rifle rounds.

items.name: Wooden Plank
items.desc: A length of two-by-four. Boards up a broken window ([F] on the empty frame) so the infected cannot climb through.

items.name: Grenade Casing
items.desc: An empty grey steel body. Fill it with powder: light for a flash, standard for a grenade, heavy for an incendiary.

items.name: Baseball Hat
items.desc: Blue and white. Keeps the sun out of your eyes and nothing else out of your head.

items.name: Sunglasses
items.desc: Dark black lenses.

items.name: Bike Helmet
items.desc: Foam and plastic. It will turn a blow; it will not turn a round.

items.name: Heavy Body Armor
items.desc: Thick black plate. Adds 110 protection on top of your health, and you feel every kilo of it.

items.name: Pink Spinel
items.desc: A small, faceted, deep pink gemstone.

items.name: Blue Spinel
items.desc: A smooth, oval, translucent deep-blue stone.

items.name: Red Spinel
items.desc: A vibrant raspberry-red, faceted gemstone.

items.name: Sapphire
items.desc: A rich royal-blue, oval-cut gemstone.

items.name: Yellow Diamond
items.desc: A brilliant golden-yellow, faceted diamond.

items.name: Amethyst
items.desc: A dark purple gemstone with reddish and greenish tones.

items.name: Gold Ring
items.desc: A gold wedding ring. Somebody stopped wearing it.

items.name: Hardhat
items.desc: A cracked construction hard hat. It was made for falling bricks, and it will still turn a glancing blow.

items.name: Scavenged Armor
items.desc: A vest of magazines bound round the body, duct-tape sleeves and a pair of knee pads. Better than a shirt.

items.name: Schoolbag
items.desc: A fraying school backpack. One strap has been mended with tape. It holds what it holds and protects nothing.

items.name: Motorcycle Helmet
items.desc: A used motorcycle helmet, visor scratched. Built for the road: it stops a blow and a pistol round on a good day.

items.name: Reinforced Rider Kit
items.desc: A leather riding jacket with elbow cups, and cargo trousers with shin guards. Made to slide down a road at speed.

items.name: Hiking Bag
items.desc: A civilian hiking pack: tall, light, comfortable, and the colour of a traffic cone.

items.name: Tactical Helmet
items.desc: A tactical bump helmet with goggles. Light, cut high over the ears, and good against fragments and handguns.

items.name: Tactical Combat Rig
items.desc: A lightweight plate carrier, cut-resistant sleeves and tactical gloves, and reinforced combat trousers.

items.name: Tactical Bag
items.desc: A modular assault backpack. The webbing takes pouches; the padding will take the edge off a hit from behind.

items.name: Ballistic Helmet
items.desc: A ballistic helmet with a face shield. Rated against rifle fragments and most of what a rifle fires.

items.name: Full Ballistic Armor
items.desc: A heavy plate carrier with side protection, shoulder and forearm guards, and tactical trousers with knee protection.

items.name: Ballistic Equipment Pack
items.desc: A compact ballistic equipment pack: a hard panel worn on the back with room behind it. Small for its price, and worth it when you are running away.

items.name: Sealed Ballistic Helmet
items.desc: A sealed ballistic helmet with a respirator. Nothing gets in: not a round, not the air. It filters like a gas mask.

items.name: Advanced Ballistic Suit
items.desc: An advanced ballistic vest over a chemical-resistant suit, sealed gauntlets with rigid protection, and reinforced contamination-resistant trousers.

items.name: Advanced Ballistic Bag
items.desc: A larger ballistic equipment pack: the same hard panel on a rigid frame, with a sealed roll top.

items.name: Smart Ballistic Helmet
items.desc: A smart ballistic helmet with thermal imaging. The best protection a head can have in the Zone.

items.name: Powered Composite Armor
items.desc: Composite armor on a powered load-bearing frame, with powered braces and reinforced boots. The frame carries its own weight: it does not slow you.

items.name: Military Warbag
items.desc: The largest bag in the game: a sack from the hips to above the head, with a bedroll under it.
